lead_raw_text:
The structure of Mn7Ni3 (Mn14Ni6 per cell) crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6_3/mmc (No. 194), with 20 atoms spanning five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies close-packed-like local arrangements for both elements: Mn centers have 12 geometric neighbors (Mn and Ni), while Ni centers have 12 neighbors (Mn and Ni). Validated polyhedron-sharing relations reveal corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among 12-vertex Mn and Ni coordination polyhedra, with edge-sharing between Mn and Ni polyhedra. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component.
